goal_coordinates: disjoint crop domains: rectangle-truncated spatial Gaussian kernels inside; four square-polar exponential sectors outside; normalized-scale continuous likelihood
goal_pair_gradient: NLL plus deterministic finite-K risk train density; detached IID samples train ST coupling via context
scheduler: 5 epoch linear warmup then 95 epoch cosine to 0.1 base LR
evaluation: 20 IID continuous domain-separated spatial-density endpoints, original draw order; 20 DDIM steps; no TTST or GT filtering
selection: best_eligible_by_H_JADE_else_best_jade; no early stop; final100 saved
validation_test_identity: mirrored official data, not independent held-out test
semantic_maps: existing dataset maps retained, not a claim that map asset generation used no external prior
default_launch: bounded explicit stop-after-epoch; no automatic long training
previous_trials: New train-only finite-K probability-mass risk; not the rejected sampled-coordinate GMM coverage loss
tail_support: outside map crop only; never competes for in-crop labels; no truncation or clipping of GT
